summary.text: EQUINOR ASA is a public limited company registered in Stavanger, founded 1972-09-18. Its website describes the business as follows: "We are an international energy company headquartered in Norway, around 25,000 employees and with offices in more than 20 countries worldwide." Its main industry code is 06.100 (utvinning av råolje). In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 106 462 000 000 USD and the annual result was 5 058 000 000 USD; operating income was up from 103 774 000 000 USD in 2024. Its verified website is equinor.com, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X profiles. Its website links to a careers page or job board. It has published 6 procurement notices as a buyer. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (OW6OFBNCKXC4US5C7523). Recent changes in the register: employees set to 21231 on 2026-10-13; latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-08-18; share capital set to 2390749040.0 on 2026-07-02.
